use: The honours cabinet; a knighthood in the Order
subject: The badge of a nineteenth-century British order of chivalry, shown flat and face-on. A many-rayed faceted silver star, at its centre a plain circular medallion within a blank enamelled band, the whole hanging from a short length of watered silk riband in pale blue with a narrow white stripe at each edge. Engraved in fine line with stipple for the metal.
